title: cortex/belief@1 — shadow temporal world-model belief record
description: The Cortex belief record (docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-2-contract-2026-07-22.md §4). Resolved via framework/triggers/schema_registry.py (closed Draft-2020-12 subset — no items/pattern keywords, so array-element shape is not validated here). identity = belief_id, a recorder-dialect digest of (kind, subject_key, dimension, provenance.event_id, adapter_ordinal); claim_digest is a STORED field, never identity. UNIT 1 validates the RECORD shape and the universal provenance minimum; the two-regime (legacy allowed-absent) provenance enforcement and the never-a-score query-shape guard land in later COG-2 units.

belief_id.description: Deterministic recorder-dialect digest of the identity tuple (never a build-time ULID)

subject_key.description: Canonical domain-scoped subject key, e.g. tasks/<task_id> — pinned per adapter, never free-text

dimension.description: The claim dimension supersession and contradiction key on (tasks: status | occurrence) — pinned mechanically per adapter

adapter_ordinal.description: 0-based index of this belief among the beliefs one adapter emits for one event (deterministic per adapter version)

claim.description: Canonical JSON claim (recorder dialect), schema-resolved; ABSENT (null) after a source purge

claim_digest.description: Recorder digest of the canonical claim bytes — a stored field, not identity; ABSENT (null) after a source purge

source_time.description: Valid time (outbox: occurred_at). Absent when unparseable per the parse-or-absent law

observation_time.description: Transaction time (outbox: occurred_at — axes degenerate, declared). Absent sorts before all present values

confidence.description: Provenance/source-trust-weighted uncertainty as a fixed-point ppm int, or ABSENT (null) = unknown — never 0, never a bare quality score

source_trust.description: {table_version, producer_key}; producer_key is a component identity (never an officer) — see cortex/source-trust@1

provenance.description: Universal minimum event_id + producer + stream_rank on EVERY belief; the v2 regime additionally carries the full envelope tuple

superseded_by.description: The belief_id that superseded this one, or ABSENT (null) when current

contradicts.description: Symmetric cross-links to conflicting beliefs (sorted); never auto-resolved

status.description: Derived, single-valued, priority source_purged > superseded > contradicted > asserted

claim_completeness.description: inline | ref_only | purged — a payload_ref envelope yields ref_only; the fold never derefs
